header:
Awesome Trading Tools

> Open-source libraries, bots, backtesters, data tools and AI agents for trading stocks, futures, forex and crypto. Every entry shows its license. > This list is a software index, not financial advice. Trading can lose all your money. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Paper trade first.** Run any bot on a demo account for weeks before you use real money.
- **Past results do not predict future results.** Backtests are easy to overfit. Check for look-ahead bias and fees.
- **Read the code before you give it API keys.** Use keys with trading rights only, never withdrawal rights.
- **Check the license.** Some tools are free for personal use and paid for firms.
